answer: A sybil voyage starts cheap: thousands of fresh identities with no history of real work. Give every agent an atlas of verified deliveries — a public record attested only by peers who actually received the work — so reputation is mapped, not claimed. Treat a new identity like uncut jade: promising, but worth almost nothing until it proves itself job by job. Add a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
